''See also: [[Sage of a Thousand Eyes Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of a [[Thousand Eyes]], also known as the [[Oracle Sage]], is a woman with an honorable reputation and ties to the [[Arelius family|Arelius]] homeland. She is described as having blonde hair streaked with gray, a pleasant but wrinkled face, and worn dark blue robes. Her primary ability involves the manifestation of numerous eyes made of [[light madra]] that swarm around her like bees. These celestial lenses allow her to see anywhere her presence can reach, providing her with vast sensory perception and the ability to transmit messages through [[Way|the Way]]. While she is a formidable opponent who can use her [[Authority|authority]] with great dexterity, she is considered slippery in combat and possesses a notable weakness in straightforward fighting, as many [[Archlord|Archlords]] are capable of matching her. There has been speculation regarding whether she is still alive following the death of her [[Monarch]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Known as the [[Oracle Sage]], this individual maintains an honorable reputation. They act as a guide for [[Mercy]] and have observed the progress of others, such as [[Eithan]] reaching the rank of [[Archlord]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of a [[Thousand Eyes]] serves as a guide to [[Mercy]]. Additionally, the [[Oracle Sage]] has made observations regarding [[Eithan]]'s progression to the rank of [[Archlord]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] can grant vision and possesses the power to see anywhere they are currently able to see. They utilize floating eyes to illustrate their commands and can forge globes of light into eyes to increase their [[Authority|authority]].}}
